findings: Nineteen full-core independent samples cover Milwaukee, DEWALT, Jauch, EEMB, SparkFun and Adafruit, PDF and HTML sources, rated/nominal/minimum/typical/stated capacity qualifications. Historical battery identities were explicitly checked without claiming current availability.
Resolved tooltip and alternate-image identity metadata issues were reopened; unsupported specifications remain null.
Source-access failures are reported separately from successful alternative HTTPS reads. Automatic schema validation is not the independent factual review.
limitations: Public product research does not establish school stock, procurement coverage, charger/device compatibility or the version of a received physical battery.
Source statements and manufacturer-family descriptions retain their exact scope.
